item.title: Thomson Reuters to Sell Stake in Legal, Tax Business to KKR
item.description: Thomson Reuters Corp. agreed to sell a 51% stake in its legal and tax publishing business to investment firm KKR & Co. in a $500 million deal.

item.title: India’s Udaan Secures $160 Million to Boost Finances Before IPO
item.description: Indian business-to-business e-commerce firm Udaan has lined up $160 million in funding to bolster its balance sheet as it prepares for a capital markets listing.

item.title: SK Hynix Early ADR Options Trading Leans to Short-Term Contracts
item.description: Options on SK Hynix Inc.’s American Depository Receipts began trading on US options exchanges Tuesday, giving traders in the world’s largest derivatives market easier access to the volatile South Korean memory chipmaker.

item.title: Boomer Wealth Transfer Set to Favor America’s Richest Families
item.description: An unprecedented transfer of wealth in the coming decades is likely to disproportionately benefit America’s most affluent families, boosting their fortunes by trillions of dollars, according to a July report from Visa Inc.

item.title: Kalshi Ramps Up Effort to Build Markets for AI Computing Power
item.description: Kalshi Inc. has created a tool that plots the future price of computing power, joining the ranks of exchange and index operators attempting to build markets around the commodity powering artificial intelligence.

item.title: Uber Is In Advanced Talks on Delivery Hero Takeover
item.description: Ride-hailing giant Uber Technologies Inc. is in advanced talks to acquire German food-delivery company Delivery Hero SE, people familiar with the matter said.

item.title: Fuel Markets in US and Europe Are Flashing Record Tightness
item.description: Fuel markets in the US and Europe are flashing record tightness as tensions flare up in the Middle East, threatening more pain for consumers already strained with high prices at the pump.

item.title: Chip Giant CXMT Seeks $9.8 Billion in Shanghai IPO
item.description: Chinese memory giant CXMT Corp. unveiled the terms of its initial public offering.

item.title: Russia Struggles to Sell All the Oil It's Being Forced to Export
item.description: The amount of Moscow’s oil at sea is back near the highs seen at the start of the year

item.title: Barito Makes More Than $5 Billion Takeover Bid for EDC
item.description: Indonesia’s PT Barito Renewables Energy has made an offer to buy geothermal company Energy Development Corp. to expand in the Philippines, people familiar with the matter said.

item.title: India Unveils Trial Index to Track Services Sector Activity
item.description: India’s new experimental measure for services sector activity showed growth across most categories in April.

item.title: India Wins Bigger Duty-Free Steel Export Quota in UK Trade Deal
item.description: India has renegotiated a higher quota for duty-free exports of steel to the UK under a free trade pact the two nations signed last year, according to Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal.

item.description: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh Photographer: Graeme Sloan/Bloomberg

item.title: Vedanta Oil to Invest $5 Billion to Boost Output Fivefold
item.description: Vedanta Oil and Gas Ltd. will invest $5 billion to expand production by more than five times, underscoring India’s push to curb reliance on energy imports.

item.title: Treasuries Rally as Cool CPI Data Cuts July Fed Hike Bets to 20%
item.description: US Treasuries surged as traders pulled back from bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes after consumer prices data came in lower than forecast.

item.title: US CPI Falls for the First Time Since 2020, Core Gauge Flat
item.description: US consumer prices declined in June for the first time in six years and a key gauge of underlying inflation was little changed, taking some pressure off the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.

item.title: Warsh Says Fed Has ‘No Tolerance’ for Elevated Inflation
item.description: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said policymakers at the central bank have no tolerance for high inflation, reiterating a vow to tame price growth that has been elevated for five years.

item.title: Dangote Ends Naira Pricing for Refined Oil Products in Nigeria
item.description: Dangote Refinery is halting the sale of petroleum products in naira within the Nigerian market, Punch Newspaper reported, citing failings in a landmark 2024 plan for the state-owned energy company to supply crude in local currency.

item.title: Software Stocks Sink as IBM Miss Delivers ‘Devastating Blow’
item.description: Shares of software and IT services companies plunged Tuesday after International Business Machines Corp. reported preliminary results that missed analyst expectations, reigniting questions over the sector’s prospects.

item.title: US Stock Futures Rise as Traders Parse CPI Data, Warsh Comments
item.description: US stock futures rose before the bell on Tuesday as investors parsed latest inflation data and Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh’s remarks.

item.title: AI Investment Race Could Turn Debt-Fueled Boom to Bust, BIS Says
item.description: The race to build infrastructure for artificial intelligence is on track to surpass previous technological booms that ended up in severe market disruptions, the Bank for International Settlements said.

item.title: US Premarket Movers for July 14, 2026
item.description: S&P 500 Index futures are little changed as of 7:50 a.m. in New York as traders refrained from taking on risk on a busy day that kicked off with Wall Street earnings.

item.title: Apple Gets Rare Bear Rating as KeyBanc Downgrades on Demand Risk
item.description: Apple Inc. received a rare bearish rating as KeyBanc Capital Markets downgraded the stock to underweight, citing concerns over both demand and valuation.

item.title: Persian Gulf’s Oil Tanker Lifeline Suffers Blow
item.description: Renewed missile attacks on ships crossing the Strait of Hormuz threaten to bolster crude’s rally.

item.title: Emerging Bond Returns Beating Treasuries as Carry Trades Boom
item.description: Emerging-market bonds’ outperformance over Treasuries is attracting growing numbers of investors looking to capitalize on the compelling carry-trade returns in the sector.

item.title: BOE’s Bailey Says Rates Would Respond to an AI Bubble Bursting
item.description: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey warned that the fallout from an artificial intelligence stocks bubble bursting would reach the UK economy and could prompt a response in interest rates.

item.title: IBM Says Second-Quarter Sales Missed as Customers Pulled Back
item.description: International Business Machines Corp. reported preliminary quarterly sales results that missed analysts estimates with Chief Executive Officer Arvind Krishna saying customers were holding back spending. The shares dropped.

item.title: Famitsu at 40: Conspiracies, Clicks and the Future of Gaming Media
item.description: The weekly publication wears its love of games proudly

item.title: Hong Kong, Onetime Mecca for Capitalism, Adopts Five-Year Planning
item.description: Hong Kong is adopting its first “five-year plan,” closely aligning it with mainland objectives.

item.title: Nebius to Sell $1 Billion in AI Capacity to Startup Reflection
item.description: Cloud provider Nebius Group NV agreed to sell more than $1 billion worth of computing power to Reflection AI, a developer of artificial intelligence models that was launched by two former Google DeepMind researchers.
